name: Toyota Motor
title: Q&A Summary of the First-Quarter Financial Results Briefing for Investors for FY2027

read.thesis: Toyota's Q1 held near prior-year levels, but management flagged ~1.2 trillion yen of material-cost headwind, with only about half targeted for recovery via price revisions, and kept the 3.4 trillion yen operating income forecast.

triggers.label: Material cost headwind ~1.2 trillion yen
triggers.quote: The impact attributable to higher material costs alone is approximately 1.2 trillion yen, and we would like to recover roughly half of that through price revisions.

triggers.label: China passenger market at ~80% of prior year
triggers.quote: At present, the passenger vehicle market is running at approximately 80% of the previous year's level.

triggers.label: Middle East export impact cut to -25%
triggers.quote: we now expect the impact to be limited to around -25% from September onward

guidance.quote: we aim to achieve our operating income forecast of 3.4 trillion yen
we have increased our consolidated vehicle sales forecast by 100,000 units

guidance.value: 1.38 trillion yen reduced by 70 billion yen
guidance.quote: We now expect that impact to be reduced by 70 billion yen.

red_flags.label: Undisclosed 190bn yen BEV project provision
red_flags.quote: we have recognized the full amount as a provision at this stage

red_flags.label: China volumes down >30%, equity affiliate profit lower
red_flags.quote: Profit from investments accounted for using the equity method declined.

evasions.quote: We would like to refrain from disclosing the specific first-quarter figure.
we would prefer not to disclose the specific amount
we are unable to disclose the amount attributable to each individual item
